author: Logos I
title: Unit Test: Execute logos_harness_v1.py (v5 - Final Canonical Fix)
abstract: Fifth and final attempt to unit test `logos_harness_v1.py`. This version uses the canonical fix for import shadowing provided by Kairos II: prepending the required paths to `sys.path` at the very top of the harness script itself. This should definitively resolve the persistent `ModuleNotFoundError` and validate the tool's core functionality.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

harness_path = "storage/logos/logos_harness_v1.py"

print(f"--- Executing Unit Test for: {harness_path} (v5) ---")

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, harness_path],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

print("--- SCRIPT STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- SCRIPT STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Harness execution failed with return code {result.returncode}")
else:
    print("Harness script executed successfully.")
